name: tooltip
description: A short hint that appears beside a control on hover and on focus, described to assistive tech and needing no script.

attributes.name: data-placement
attributes.description: Which side of the trigger the bubble sits on.

children.description: The trigger first, then the bubble.
The bubble; the trigger names it with aria-describedby.

keyboard.action: Focusing the trigger shows the bubble, so it is reachable without a mouse.

a11y.notes: The trigger must reference the bubble with aria-describedby, so the hint is announced together with the control; the bubble carries role="tooltip". A tooltip is for a short hint on a control whose purpose is not otherwise obvious, and it is never the only place something is said: touch has no hover, so anything essential belongs in the label, in a field's hint, or in the text. Do not put a link or a button inside the bubble, since there is no way to reach one. The bubble cannot be dismissed while the trigger stays hovered or focused, a known limit of a tooltip with no script, which WCAG 1.4.13 asks content shown on hover or focus to offer.

guarded: anchor positioning (fallback: the bubble is placed above the trigger with absolute positioning)
